goal: Enhance the shipped Ashen Rift 3DS game: feel, density, variety, audio, polish — without ever breaking the build or the 30fps floor.

userStories.title: Calibration: build probe constant wired through main
userStories.description: Create include/demake/build_probe.hpp declaring exactly: `namespace demake { constexpr int kRalphLoopGeneration = 1; }` with a header guard. In source/main.cpp, add `#include "demake/build_probe.hpp"` and a `static_assert(demake::kRalphLoopGeneration >= 1, "ralph probe");` at file scope. Touch nothing else. main.cpp is 20 lines; re-emit it completely.
userStories.verify: tools/ralph-verify.sh quick && grep -q 'kRalphLoopGeneration' include/demake/build_probe.hpp && grep -q 'demake/build_probe.hpp' source/main.cpp && grep -q 'static_assert(demake::kRalphLoopGeneration' source/main.cpp
